title: services: military send_troops, preview_send, recall_reinforcement, return arrival
criteria:
Create realm/services/military.py with: send_troops, preview_send, recall_reinforcement, create_return_movement and resolve_arrival (ONLY the 'return' mission is implemented now; every other mission raises NotImplementedError('T13b') inside resolve_arrival so a later task fills it). Never commit, never call datetime.now(). Signatures: send_troops(s, player_id, from_village_id, to_x, to_y, mission, units, now, cfg, catapult_target=None) -> Movement; preview_send(same args) -> SendPreview (realm.services.views); recall_reinforcement(s, player_id, troop_id, now, cfg) -> Movement; create_return_movement(s, home_village_id, origin_x, origin_y, player_id, units, loot, now, cfg) -> Movement; resolve_arrival(s, movement_id, now, cfg) -> None.
Tests in tests/services/test_military_send.py (DB fixtures `s`, `cfg`, `t0`). Helper: world = worlds.create_world(s, seed=1, speed=1, player_name='ผู้เล่น', tribe='stonehold', bot_count=1, cfg=cfg, real_now=t0); the player's village A and the single bot's village B; then force a known geometry with direct DB updates: set B.x=7, B.y=0 (A is at (0,0)), set rally_point (slot 39) level 1 in A, give A troops with Troop(home=A, location=A, unit=..., count=...) rows, and set bot.protection_until = t0 - 1 day when an attack should be allowed. Hand-computed expectations:
- send 10 light_cavalry raid A->(7,0) at t0 as stonehold: travel time 7/14*3600 = 1800 s so arrive_at == t0+1800s; the Troop rows of A for light_cavalry are gone (rows deleted at count 0; for a partial send the row keeps the remainder), a Movement row exists (mission 'raid', from_village_id A, to_x 7, to_y 0, to_village_id B, units {'light_cavalry': 10}, status 'moving', departed_at t0), one pending MOVEMENT_ARRIVE event due at arrive_at with payload {'movement_id': id}; villages.compute_rates(A) food rate is unchanged by the send (units moving still cost upkeep).
- coordinates wrap: to_x=108 (7+101) behaves like 7.
- preview_send for the same input returns distance 7.0, travel_time_s 1800.0, arrive_at t0+1800s, carry 800.0 (10*80, stonehold carry_mult 1) and errors [] and changes NOTHING in the DB (count Movement/Event rows before and after).
- errors: no rally point (level 0) -> REQUIREMENTS_NOT_MET; not enough troops (ask 11 with 10 available) -> NO_UNITS; empty units or invalid mission units (scout mission with spearman) -> INVALID_UNITS; mission SETTLE -> INVALID_UNITS with message 'ยังไม่เปิดใช้'; sending mission RETURN manually -> INVALID_TARGET; attack/raid/scout at an empty tile -> INVALID_TARGET; target tile is the sender village itself -> INVALID_TARGET; hostile mission against a village of the same player -> INVALID_TARGET; target owner under protection (bot.protection_until = t0 + 1 hour) with raid/attack/scout -> PROTECTED, and nothing changes; reinforce at a protected owner is allowed; another player's id -> FORBIDDEN; unknown from village -> NOT_FOUND; unknown catapult_target building key -> INVALID_TARGET.
- the attacker's own protection: human protection_until is 72 h after t0; after a successful raid/attack/scout send at t0 it equals t0 (protection lost); after a reinforce send it is unchanged.
- preview_send returns the same errors as a failing send would raise, as a list of Thai messages (e.g. PROTECTED case -> ['เป้าหมายยังอยู่ในช่วงคุ้มครอง']) and never raises GameError for rule violations.
- recall_reinforcement: Troop(home=A, location=B, unit='spearman', count=5) -> returns a Movement mission 'return' from_village_id A, to_x/to_y = B's coordinates, units {'spearman': 5}, arrive_at t0 + 3600 s (7 tiles at spearman speed 7), the Troop row is deleted, a MOVEMENT_ARRIVE event is scheduled; recalling a troop whose home == location -> INVALID_TARGET; recalling another player's troop -> FORBIDDEN; unknown troop -> NOT_FOUND.
- resolve_arrival for a 'return' movement at its arrive_at: units are added back to A's Troop row (home=location=A, upsert), loot {'wood': 300, 'stone': 0, 'iron': 0, 'food': 0} is added to A's stock (settle first) and capped at capacity (stock 750 + 300 = 1050 > capacity 800 -> 800), movement.status == 'done', A is re-settled with after_change; running resolve_arrival again for a 'done' movement is a no-op; the process_next worker (realm.engine.worker) is NOT touched in this task.
notes:
DESIGN (follow exactly):
- Shared private helper `_check_send(s, player_id, from_village_id, to_x, to_y, mission, units, now, cfg, catapult_target, lock: bool)` returning a context object/tuple plus a list of (code, thai_message) problems; send_troops raises GameError(code, message) for the FIRST problem (codes: REQUIREMENTS_NOT_MET, INVALID_UNITS, NO_UNITS, INVALID_TARGET, PROTECTED, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND) while preview_send turns ALL problems except NOT_FOUND/FORBIDDEN into the errors list of SendPreview (NOT_FOUND/FORBIDDEN still raise). preview_send must not lock rows for update nor modify anything (no settle, no protection change).
- Check order in send_troops: lock village (villages.lock_village) -> owner check (FORBIDDEN, villages.FORBIDDEN_TH) -> villages.settle_village -> mission RETURN -> INVALID_TARGET 'ภารกิจนี้ส่งเองไม่ได้' -> mission SETTLE -> INVALID_UNITS 'ยังไม่เปิดใช้' -> rally_point level >= 1 else REQUIREMENTS_NOT_MET f'ต้องมี {cfg.buildings["rally_point"].name_th} เลเวล 1' -> units.validate_mission_units errors -> INVALID_UNITS (messages joined with ', ') -> catapult_target not None and not in cfg.buildings -> INVALID_TARGET 'ไม่พบอาคารนี้' -> target tile: tx = movement.wrap(to_x, world.size), ty = movement.wrap(to_y, world.size); target village = the Village of this world at (tx, ty) or None -> same tile as the sender -> INVALID_TARGET 'เป้าหมายคือหมู่บ้านตัวเอง' -> ATTACK/RAID/SCOUT: no target village -> INVALID_TARGET 'ไม่มีหมู่บ้านที่เป้าหมาย'; target owned by the same player -> INVALID_TARGET 'เป้าหมายคือหมู่บ้านตัวเอง'; target owner's protection_until > now -> PROTECTED 'เป้าหมายยังอยู่ในช่วงคุ้มครอง' -> REINFORCE: no target village -> INVALID_TARGET 'ไม่มีหมู่บ้านที่เป้าหมาย' -> the home troops: sum Troop rows with home_village_id == location_village_id == A per unit; not enough -> NO_UNITS 'ทหารไม่พอ'.
- After the checks: if the mission is hostile (ATTACK/RAID/SCOUT) and the sender's player.protection_until > now: set player.protection_until = now. Deduct the troops (decrement the Troop row count, delete the row when it reaches 0). distance = movement.distance(A.x, A.y, tx, ty, world.size); seconds = movement.travel_time_s(units, player.tribe, distance, world.speed, cfg); arrive_at = now + timedelta(seconds=seconds); insert the Movement (units stored as a plain dict of the positive counts, loot {}), flush, events.schedule(s, world_id, EventType.MOVEMENT_ARRIVE, arrive_at, {'movement_id': id}), villages.after_change(s, village, now, cfg), notify.notify(s, world_id, [sender player id] + [target owner id when there is a target village and it differs], 'village', village.id), return the Movement.
- preview carry = units.carry_capacity(units, player.tribe, cfg); distance/travel_time as above (0.0 and arrive_at=now when the army is empty/invalid).
- recall_reinforcement: troop = s.get(Troop, troop_id) None -> NOT_FOUND 'ไม่พบทัพเสริม'; home village owner != player_id -> FORBIDDEN; troop.home_village_id == troop.location_village_id -> INVALID_TARGET 'ไม่ใช่ทัพเสริม'; lock BOTH villages ordered by id ascending; settle both; delete the Troop row; return create_return_movement(s, home_id, location.x, location.y, player_id, {unit: count}, {}, now, cfg).
- create_return_movement: distance from (origin_x, origin_y) to the home village; seconds via movement.travel_time_s; Movement(mission 'return', from_village_id = home village, to_x/to_y = origin, to_village_id = None, units, loot as dict of resource -> amount (floats ok), status 'moving'); schedule MOVEMENT_ARRIVE; notify the owner; returns the Movement. (The home village is the DESTINATION of a return trip even though it is stored in from_village_id; keep that convention.)
- resolve_arrival: m = s.get(Movement, id); None or status != 'moving' -> return; mission 'return': lock the home village (m.from_village_id), settle_village(now), upsert Troop (home=location=village) += units, add loot (Res.from_dict) to the stock then clamp to [0, capacity] using villages.compute_rates for the capacity, set status 'done', flush, after_change, notify the owner; other missions: raise NotImplementedError('T13b').
- Thai strings: use ONLY the strings written in single quotes above (copy letter by letter; they were proofread) plus the reused constants from realm.services.villages (FORBIDDEN_TH, VILLAGE_NOT_FOUND_TH via lock_village). Do not type any other Thai.
- If a unit-count dict contains zero/negative counts ignore those entries; store only positive counts. Lock order rule: when locking several villages, ascending id.
